# Supported functions

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/generate-functions.ts from
     packages/core/src/locale/functions/en.ts. Do not edit by hand;
     run `bun run docs:functions` instead. -->

TinySheet ships 469 worksheet functions. Every one of them
appears in formula autocomplete, shows an argument hint while you type,
and is listed in the function search dialog. Arguments in `[brackets]`
are optional; `...` means the argument can be repeated.

## Lookup and reference

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ADDRESS(row_num, column_num, [abs_num], [a1], [sheet_text])` | Cell address as text. |
| `CHOOSE(index_num, value1, [value2, ...])` | Picks a value from a list by index. |
| `CHOOSECOLS(array, col_num1, [col_num2, ...])` | Selected columns of an array. |
| `CHOOSEROWS(array, row_num1, [row_num2, ...])` | Selected rows of an array. |
| `COLUMN([reference])` | Column number of a reference. |
| `COLUMNS(array)` | Number of columns in a range. |
| `DROP(array, rows, [columns])` | Array without its first or last rows/columns. |
| `EXPAND(array, rows, [columns], [pad_with])` | Pads an array to a given size. |
| `FILTER(array, include, [if_empty])` | Rows or columns that meet criteria. |
| `FORMULATEXT(reference)` | Formula of a cell as text. |
| `HLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, row_index_num, [range_lookup])` | Horizontal lookup. |
| `HSTACK(array1, [array2, ...])` | Stacks arrays side by side. |
| `HYPERLINK(link_location, [friendly_name])` | Creates a hyperlink. |
| `INDEX(array, row_num, [column_num])` | Value at a row and column of a range. |
| `INDIRECT(ref_text, [a1])` | Reference from a text string. |
| `LOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_vector, [result_vector])` | Looks up a value in a vector. |
| `MATCH(lookup_value, lookup_array, [match_type])` | Position of a value in a range. |
| `OFFSET(reference, rows, cols, [height], [width])` | Reference offset from a starting point. |
| `ROW([reference])` | Row number of a reference. |
| `ROWS(array)` | Number of rows in a range. |
| `SORT(array, [sort_index], [sort_order], [by_col])` | Sorts a range or array. |
| `SORTBY(array, by_array1, [sort_order1], [by_array2, ...], [sort_order2, ...])` | Sorts by values in other ranges. |
| `TAKE(array, rows, [columns])` | First or last rows/columns of an array. |
| `TOCOL(array, [ignore], [scan_by_column])` | Flattens an array into one column. |
| `TOROW(array, [ignore], [scan_by_column])` | Flattens an array into one row. |
| `TRANSPOSE(array)` | Swaps rows and columns. |
| `TRIMRANGE(range, [trim_rows], [trim_cols])` | Trims empty edges from a range. |
| `UNIQUE(array, [by_col], [exactly_once])` | Unique values of a range. |
| `VLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, col_index_num, [range_lookup])` | Vertical lookup. |
| `VSTACK(array1, [array2, ...])` | Stacks arrays on top of each other. |
| `WRAPCOLS(vector, wrap_count, [pad_with])` | Wraps a vector into columns. |
| `WRAPROWS(vector, wrap_count, [pad_with])` | Wraps a vector into rows. |
| `XLOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_array, return_array, [if_not_found], [match_mode], [search_mode])` | Looks up a value and returns a match. |
| `XMATCH(lookup_value, lookup_array, [match_mode], [search_mode])` | Position of a value in a range. |

## Logical

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `AND(logical1, [logical2, ...])` | TRUE if all arguments are TRUE. |
| `BYCOL(array, lambda)` | Applies a LAMBDA to each column. |
| `BYROW(array, lambda)` | Applies a LAMBDA to each row. |
| `FALSE()` | The logical value FALSE. |
| `IF(logical_test, value_if_true, [value_if_false])` | Chooses a value based on a condition. |
| `IFERROR(value, value_if_error)` | Fallback value on error. |
| `IFNA(value, value_if_na)` | Fallback value on #N/A. |
| `IFS(logical_test1, value_if_true1, [logical_test2, ...], [value_if_true2, ...])` | Value for the first TRUE condition. |
| `LAMBDA([parameter, ...], calculation)` | Creates a custom function. |
| `LET(name1, name_value1, calculation_or_name2, [name_value2, ...], [calculation_or_name3, ...])` | Names values inside a formula. |
| `MAKEARRAY(rows, cols, lambda)` | Builds an array with a LAMBDA. |
| `MAP(array1, [array2, ...], lambda)` | Transforms each value with a LAMBDA. |
| `NOT(logical)` | Reverses a logical value. |
| `OR(logical1, [logical2, ...])` | TRUE if any argument is TRUE. |
| `REDUCE([initial_value], array, lambda)` | Reduces an array to a single value. |
| `SCAN([initial_value], array, lambda)` | Running accumulation with a LAMBDA. |
| `SWITCH(expression, value1, result1, [default_or_value2, ...], [result2, ...])` | Result for the first matching value. |
| `TRUE()` | The logical value TRUE. |
| `XOR(logical1, [logical2, ...])` | Exclusive OR of arguments. |

| `FIND(find_text, within_text, [start_num])` | Position of text within text (case-sensitive). |

| `LEN(text)` | Length of text. |
| `LOWER(text)` | Converts text to lowercase. |
| `MID(text, start_num, num_chars)` | Characters from the middle of text. |
| `NUMBERVALUE(text, [decimal_separator], [group_separator])` | Converts text to a number with custom separators. |
| `PROPER(text)` | Capitalizes each word. |
| `REGEXEXTRACT(text, pattern, [return_mode], [case_sensitivity])` | Text that matches a regular expression. |

| `REGEXTEST(text, pattern, [case_sensitivity])` | Checks text against a regular expression. |
| `REPLACE(old_text, start_num, num_chars, new_text)` | Replaces characters at a position. |
| `REPT(text, number_times)` | Repeats text. |
| `RIGHT(text, [num_chars])` | Rightmost characters of text. |
| `SEARCH(find_text, within_text, [start_num])` | Position of text within text (case-insensitive). |
| `SUBSTITUTE(text, old_text, new_text, [instance_num])` | Replaces occurrences of text. |
| `T(value)` | Returns text, or "" for other values. |
| `TEXT(value, format_text)` | Formats a number as text. |
| `TEXTAFTER(text, delimiter, [instance_num], [match_mode], [match_end], [if_not_found])` | Text after a delimiter. |
| `TEXTBEFORE(text, delimiter, [instance_num], [match_mode], [match_end], [if_not_found])` | Text before a delimiter. |
| `TEXTJOIN(delimiter, ignore_empty, text1, [text2, ...])` | Joins text with a delimiter. |
| `TEXTSPLIT(text, col_delimiter, [row_delimiter], [ignore_empty], [match_mode], [pad_with])` | Splits text into an array. |
| `TRIM(text)` | Removes extra spaces. |
| `UNICHAR(number)` | Unicode character from a code point. |
| `UNICODE(text)` | Code point of the first character. |
| `UPPER(text)` | Converts text to uppercase. |
| `VALUE(text)` | Converts text to a number. |
| `VALUETOTEXT(value, [format])` | Converts a value to text. |
